'''Juna Helos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who settled in the [[Copero Villa]] on [[Copero/Legends|Copero]] during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.4.1}} 7.4.1 can be placed around [[3623 BBY]].</ref> Helos asked the [[Alliance Commander]] to retrieve relics from the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Juna Helos first appeared in the [[March]] [[2024]] Game Update 7.4.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
